features.title: Initial Onboarding Tutorial Tooltips
features.desired_outcome: First-time players see clear, non-intrusive instructional text prompts during their initial steps on Moss Trail.
features.reason: Currently, a new player is dropped straight into the walk sequence with zero context or instruction.

features.title: Route Discovery & Collection Milestones Ledger
features.desired_outcome: Add an in-game menu interface tracking discovered route items, completion counts, and collection milestone rewards.
features.reason: As an explorer, knowing which collectibles or secrets remain unvisited on routes like Gloomwood Hollow or Moon Shrine drives long-term engagement.

features.title: Elite Combat Waves & Aggressive Enemy Behaviors
features.desired_outcome: Request engine support for elite enemy profiles and multi-wave encounter triggers on difficulty 3+ routes.
features.reason: Current high-difficulty routes lack sufficient enemy friction, making combat feel like an afterthought rather than a core pillar of mastery.

features.title: Combat Mastery Modifiers (Flawless Bonus)
features.desired_outcome: Add a content modifier that grants bonus coin multipliers or rare crafting materials when completing routes with 100% HP.
features.reason: Rewarding clean combat execution directly aligns with the challenge-and-mastery player persona.

features.title: Elite Cosmetic Saving Progress Bar
features.desired_outcome: Add a UI progress tracker in the marketplace showing coin savings toward locked luxury items.
features.reason: After buying two mid-tier cosmetics, the player was left with 21 coins and an explicit 'Not enough coins' block, which can feel discouraging without a clear target.

features.title: Visible Keyboard Focus Rings and High-Contrast Theme Option
features.desired_outcome: Add distinct keyboard focus states and a high-contrast visual toggle in settings.
features.reason: Currently, interface elements lack clear focus indicators, which increases cognitive load when operating the game without a mouse.

features.title: Obstacle Input Buffering & Command Feedback
features.desired_outcome: Add client-side command validation and input buffering so blocked walk commands prompt an immediate warning state rather than multiple penalty ticks.
features.reason: Edge-case telemetry shows players frequently spam movement commands when blocked by hazards, leading to frustrating unintended damage states.

features.title: Elite Enemy Behavior Profiles for Difficulty 3+ Routes
features.reason: Combat challengers reported low enemy encounter density and mechanical friction on high-tier routes.

features.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
features.reason: Explorers and collectors desire an in-game tracking interface for unique route items and completion rewards.

features.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
features.reason: First-time players need welcome tooltips at step 0 to understand initial movement and combat mechanics.

features.title: High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States
features.reason: Accessibility council noted that marketplace navigation and UI elements need clearer keyboard focus rings.

features.title: Movement Command Validation & Obstacle Input Buffering
features.reason: Edge-case telemetry shows redundant walk commands attempting to queue against active hazard collisions.

policy.note: AI beta-test recommendations are advisory. The owner manually implements changes with ChatGPT and uses Development Review only to monitor status.
